watch.summary: The creator passionately yells and jumps out of his chair while reacting to a disrespectful defuse during a pro Valorant match.

beats.what: The creator listens to caster audio while watching a pro Valorant round unfold.
The pro player finishes the defuse right in the opponent's face.
The creator jumps up from his chair, screaming 'GET HIM OUT OF HERE!' in pure hype.
